title: NFC Smart Rings
description: NFC smart rings in ceramic, wood and other materials for wearable access, profile sharing and tap-triggered interactions in a ring form factor.
summary: NFC rings bring contactless functionality into a wearable ring format for access, sharing and other tap-triggered interactions without carrying a card or keyfob.
Microcrystalline zirconium ceramic body, Comfortable to wear.
High-strength special ceramics production, professional evaluation of 1 metre drop without obstruction.

faq.question: What are NFC Smart Rings commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for wearable NFC access, quick profile sharing, smart-scene triggering and niche branded programs where a ring is the preferred form factor.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for NFC Smart Rings?
faq.answer: Chip: ATA5577, Mifare S50, Mifare S70, Ntag213, Ntag215, Ntag216, Protocol: ISO14443A, ISO14443B, 15693 Frequency: 125khz, 13.56MHZ Read Range: 1 – 5cm(depends on reader)
